title: Perform security audit focused on tenant isolation verification
acceptance_criteria: Audit checklist created covering: RLS policies, tenant_id scoping, session tenant_id injection, 404 vs 403
Every API route reviewed for tenant_id scope: create, read, update, delete operations all scoped
Direct DB queries (non-repository) checked for missing tenant_id filters
AsyncLocalStorage tenant context verified for all async paths (no context leaks)
RLS FORCE policies tested with direct SQL to verify cross-tenant filtering
Session integrity verified: tenant_id in session cannot be tampered with client-side
Audit findings documented with severity and remediation steps
